name: Sign Language Translator
description: Real-time sign language translation for live video meetings with webcam subtitles, personalized gesture model training, complete ASL & ISL dictionary with HD videos, an AI Sign Evaluator comparing user gestures with reference blueprints to provide accuracy scores, joint-level mistake highlights, and actionable coaching tips, a competitive Multiplayer Practice Mode with dual webcam feeds, live landmark comparison, real-time scoreboards, and challenge modes, alongside an interactive Learning Dashboard.
